segment_captions.caption: A baby sits in a stroller near a chain-link fence, looking around. The stroller is stationary, and the baby appears calm and observant of the surroundings.
Baby in stroller looks around, then reaches out with right hand towards fence.
C adjusts the stroller handle while the baby looks around the fence.

C sits in a stroller, holding onto the handle, watching a train pass by through a fence.
